title: 唯一分解整环上的多项式环
Polynomials over a unique factorization domain
本原看所有系数，不只看首项
Primitive means no common coefficient factor
text: 本节 D 为 UFD，F=Frac(D)。非零多项式的系数 gcd 称内容（补充记号 c(f)），仅在相伴意义下确定；内容为单位的多项式称本原。
Throughout, D is a UFD and F=Frac(D). The content c(f) of a nonzero polynomial is the gcd of its coefficients, defined up to a unit. A polynomial is primitive when its content is a unit.
example: 2x+3 本原但不首一；6x²+9x 的内容为 3，本原部分为 2x²+3x。任何首一多项式本原，反之不成立。
The polynomial 2x+3 is primitive but not monic. The content of 6x²+9x is 3, with primitive part 2x²+3x. Monic implies primitive, not conversely.

title: 先清分母，再提取内容
Clear denominators and extract content
entries.tex: 0\ne f\in F[x]\Rightarrow f=r f_0,\quad r\in F^\times,\ f_0\in D[x]\text{ primitive}
text: 任意非零 F 系数多项式都能写为标量乘 D 上本原多项式。若 f 本来在 D[x] 中，标量可取在 D 中。两种表示的标量之比是 D 的单位。
Every nonzero polynomial over F is a scalar times a primitive polynomial over D. If it already belongs to D[x], the scalar can be chosen in D. Two such scalars differ by a unit of D.
proof: 取所有系数分母的乘积 b≠0，使 bf∈D[x]。令 a 为 bf 的系数 gcd，逐项除以 a 得本原 f₀，于是 f=(a/b)f₀。
Multiply by a common denominator b. Divide bf by its coefficient gcd a to obtain a primitive f₀ and f=(a/b)f₀.
对任意素元 p，把 vₚ 扩充到 F×。本原多项式的所有非零系数的 vₚ 最小值为 0。
Extend prime exponents vₚ to F×. For a primitive polynomial, the minimum coefficient exponent is zero at every prime.
若 rf₀=r′g₀ 且两者本原，比较两边系数的最小 vₚ，得 vₚ(r)=vₚ(r′)。故 r′/r 在每个素元处指数为 0，是 D 的单位。
If rf₀=r′g₀ with both primitive, compare the minimum coefficient exponents: vₚ(r)=vₚ(r′) for every prime. Their ratio is therefore a unit of D.

title: 高斯引理：本原性在乘法下保持
Gauss’s lemma: primitive products stay primitive
text: D 为 UFD 时，本原多项式的乘积仍本原。关键是不可约元在 D 中为素元，因而可以模它取商，得到整环。
Over a UFD, the product of primitive polynomials is primitive. The key is that an irreducible of D is prime, so quotienting by it gives a domain.
proof: 反设 fg 所有系数有公共不可约因子 p。由于 D 为 UFD，p 是素元，所以 D/(p) 为整环。
Suppose an irreducible p divides every coefficient of fg. In a UFD p is prime, so D/(p) is a domain.
f,g 本原，故各有系数不被 p 整除，模 p 后得到非零多项式 f̄,ḡ。
Primitivity makes both reduced polynomials f̄,ḡ nonzero.
整环上的多项式环仍为整环，故 f̄ḡ≠0；却与 fg 所有系数被 p 整除矛盾。
Their product cannot vanish in the polynomial ring over D/(p), contradicting the assumption.
extraProof: 教材的系数证明：取 f、g 中第一个不被 p 整除的系数 aₖ、bℓ。乘积的 xᵏ⁺ℓ 系数里，除 aₖbℓ 外的项都被 p 整除，而这一项不被 p 整除，矛盾。
Textbook coefficient proof: take the first coefficients aₖ,bℓ not divisible by p. In degree k+ℓ every other summand is divisible by p, but aₖbℓ is not.

title: 内容的乘法规则
Contents multiply up to a unit
text: 非零多项式 f,g 的内容满足上式。在 ℤ[x] 中把内容规范为正数，就得到真正的相等。
For nonzero polynomials, content is multiplicative up to associates. In ℤ[x], choosing positive contents turns this into equality.

label: 补充 · 高斯引理的推论
Supplementary result

proof: 写 f=c(f)f₀、g=c(g)g₀，其中 f₀,g₀ 本原。高斯引理说明 f₀g₀ 本原。
Write f=c(f)f₀ and g=c(g)g₀. Gauss’s lemma makes f₀g₀ primitive.
于是 fg=c(f)c(g)(f₀g₀)。内容的唯一性给出 c(fg) 与 c(f)c(g) 相伴。
Thus fg=c(f)c(g)(f₀g₀), and uniqueness of the primitive decomposition gives the result.
example: (2x+3)(3x+2)=6x²+13x+6 的内容为 1。即使首项与常数项都为 6，全部系数仍无公共素因子。
The product (2x+3)(3x+2)=6x²+13x+6 has content 1, despite its leading and constant coefficients both being 6.

title: 在商域分解，不会偷偷多出因子
Factorization over the fraction field descends
entries.tex: f\text{ primitive},\ \deg f>0:\quad f\text{ reducible in }D[x]\iff f\text{ reducible in }F[x]
text: 对正次数本原多项式，在 D[x] 与 F[x] 中的可约性等价。本原条件防止把“非单位常数因子”误当成商域中的真正因子。
For a positive-degree primitive polynomial, reducibility over D and over its fraction field F are equivalent. Primitivity excludes nonunit constant factors that become units over F.
proof: D[x] 中的本原 f 若分成两个非单位，则两因子都为正次数；否则非单位常数会整除全部系数。因此该分解在 F[x] 中仍非平凡。
In a factorization of primitive f into nonunits in D[x], both factors have positive degree; a nonunit constant would divide every coefficient. Thus it stays nontrivial over F.
反向若 f=gh 在 F[x] 中非平凡，写 g=rg₀、h=sh₀，g₀,h₀ 本原且次数不变。
Conversely, write a nontrivial factorization f=gh over F as g=rg₀, h=sh₀ with primitive parts of the same degrees.
高斯引理给出 g₀h₀ 本原；与本原 f 比较，定理 4.5.2 得 rs 为 D 的单位，故 f=(rsg₀)h₀ 是 D[x] 中非平凡分解。
Gauss’s lemma makes g₀h₀ primitive. Theorem 4.5.2 forces rs to be a unit of D, giving the factorization in D[x].
warning: 2x+2 在 ℤ[x] 中可约（2·(x+1)），在 ℚ[x] 中却是一次不可约多项式；它不是本原的。
The nonprimitive polynomial 2x+2 is reducible in ℤ[x] but is linear and irreducible in ℚ[x].

title: D[x] 的不可约元来自两类
Two sources of irreducibles in D[x]
text: D[x] 中不可约元要么是 D 的不可约常数，要么是正次数本原多项式，且在 F[x] 中不可约。反过来这两类也确实不可约。
The irreducibles of D[x] are irreducible constants of D and primitive positive-degree polynomials irreducible over F. Both types really are irreducible.
proof: 零次多项式的分解只能有零次因子，所以常数不可约性与 D 中相同。
A constant can only factor into constants in a polynomial ring over a domain, so its irreducibility is the same as in D.
正次数不可约 f 若内容为非单位，则 f=c(f)f₀ 已是两个非单位之积，矛盾。故它本原。
A positive-degree irreducible cannot have nonunit content, since that would give a nontrivial factorization.
对本原的正次数部分，应用定理 4.5.4 即得双向结论。
Apply Theorem 4.5.4 to the primitive positive-degree part.
example: ℤ[x] 中 2、x、x²+1 都不可约；2 在 ℚ[x] 中却是单位。讨论不可约前必须写清系数环。
In ℤ[x], 2, x and x²+1 are irreducible; in ℚ[x], 2 is a unit. Always specify the coefficient ring.

title: 主定理：UFD 上的多项式环仍是 UFD
The main theorem: D[x] is a UFD
text: 先提取内容，在 D 中分解常数部分，再在 F[x] 中分解本原部分并清分母。唯一性则分别来自 D 和 F[x]，最后用本原性把 F 的单位缩回 D 的单位。
Factor the content in D, factor the primitive part in F[x], then clear denominators. Uniqueness comes from D and F[x]; primitivity reduces scalar associates over F to unit associates over D.
proof: F 是域，所以 F[x] 是 ED，因而 UFD。写非零 f=cf₀，其中 f₀ 本原；c 在 D 中有唯一分解。
Since F is a field, F[x] is an ED and hence a UFD. Write f=cf₀ with f₀ primitive; factor c in D.
在 F[x] 中分解 f₀；每个正次数不可约因子可写成标量乘 D 上本原多项式 qᵢ。由定理 4.5.4，qᵢ 在 D[x] 中不可约。
Factor f₀ in F[x] and replace each factor by a scalar times a primitive polynomial qᵢ over D. Theorem 4.5.4 makes each qᵢ irreducible in D[x].
qᵢ 的积本原，与 f₀ 比较可知所有标量的乘积是 D 的单位。结合 c 的分解，得到 D[x] 中不可约分解的存在性。
The product of the qᵢ is primitive, so comparison with f₀ forces the product of the scalars to be a unit of D. This proves existence.
对任意两种分解，用内容乘法性比较常数不可约因子；D 中唯一性使它们一一相伴。
For two factorizations, multiplicativity of content and uniqueness in D match the constant irreducible factors up to associates.
剩下正次数本原因子。在 F[x] 中的唯一性使它们重排后相差 F 的非零标量；两边本原迫使每个标量其实是 D 的单位。因此 D[x] 中也唯一。
Uniqueness in F[x] matches the remaining positive-degree primitive factors up to nonzero scalars. Primitivity forces each scalar to be a unit of D, proving uniqueness in D[x].

title: 多元仍唯一分解，但未必主理想
Several variables preserve UFD, not PID
text: 对变量数归纳，逐次应用一元主定理即可。尤其 ℤ[x₁,…,xₙ] 与 F[x₁,…,xₙ] 都是 UFD，但两个或更多变量的域系数多项式环不是 PID。
Induct on the number of variables using the one-variable theorem. In particular ℤ[x₁,…,xₙ] and F[x₁,…,xₙ] are UFDs. Over a field, two or more variables do not give a PID.
proof: n=1 已证。若 D[x₁,…,xₙ₋₁] 为 UFD，再对它添加 xₙ，仍为 UFD。
The one-variable case is proved. Apply it again to the UFD D[x₁,…,xₙ₋₁].
在 F[x,y] 中，若 (x,y)=(d)，则 d 同时整除 x 与 y，只能为单位；可 (x,y) 的元素常数项均为 0，不含 1，矛盾。
If (x,y)=(d) in F[x,y], then d divides both x and y and must be a unit. But every element of (x,y) has zero constant term, so it is proper, a contradiction.
example: 本章的概念链：ED ⇒ PID ⇒ UFD ⇒ 整环。ℤ、F[x]、ℤ[i] 在最左侧；ℤ[x]、F[x,y] 说明 UFD 比 PID 更宽。
The chapter’s hierarchy is ED ⇒ PID ⇒ UFD ⇒ domain. The integers, F[x] and ℤ[i] are Euclidean; ℤ[x] and F[x,y] separate UFD from PID.

title: 把高斯引理用于不可约性
Using Gauss’s lemma to prove irreducibility
entries.tex: \deg\bar f=\deg f,\quad\bar f\text{ irreducible in }\mathbb F_p[x]\quad\Longrightarrow f\text{ irreducible in }\mathbb Q[x]
text: 对本原的正次数 f∈ℤ[x]，若模素数 p 后次数不变且不可约，则 f 在 ℚ[x]、ℤ[x] 中不可约。演示仅对二次或三次多项式用“无根”判别，绝不把它套到高次。
For primitive positive-degree f∈ℤ[x], an irreducible reduction modulo p of unchanged degree proves irreducibility over ℚ and ℤ. The demo uses the no-root test only in degrees two and three.

label: 补充 · 模素数判别法
Supplementary result

proof: 反设 f 在 ℚ[x] 中可约。高斯引理给出 f=gh，g,h∈ℤ[x] 且次数都为正。
If f were reducible over ℚ, Gauss’s lemma would give f=gh in ℤ[x] with both degrees positive.
p 不整除 f 的首项系数，因而不整除 g、h 的首项系数。模 p 后两因子次数均不变，仍是非平凡分解，矛盾。
Since p does not divide the leading coefficient of f, it divides neither factor’s leading coefficient. Both degrees survive reduction, contradicting irreducibility modulo p.
二、三次多项式可约时，两个正次数因子中必有一个一次因子；一次因子等价于有根，故这些次数下无根等价于不可约。
A reducible quadratic or cubic has a linear factor, equivalent to a root. Only in these degrees does no root imply irreducibility.
warning: 模 p 可约只能说明该方法未能判定，不能推出 f 在 ℚ 上可约；例如 x²+1 模 2 可约，但在 ℚ 上不可约。
A reducible reduction is inconclusive: x²+1 is reducible modulo 2 but irreducible over ℚ.

question: 6x²+9x 在 ℤ[x] 中的正内容是什么？
What is the positive content of 6x²+9x in ℤ[x]?
reason: 系数 6、9、0 的正 gcd 为 3。

question: 哪个多项式本原但不首一？
Which is primitive but not monic?
reason: 2、3 互素而首项系数为 2；x²+1 则本原且首一。
The coefficients 2,3 are coprime, but the leading coefficient is 2.

question: 本原多项式 f,g 的乘积具有什么性质？
What is guaranteed for primitive f,g over a UFD?
reason: 这是高斯引理；本原性不等于不可约性。
This is Gauss’s lemma. Primitivity is not irreducibility.

question: 四次多项式在 𝔽₂ 中无根，可以断定什么？
What follows if a quartic has no roots in 𝔽₂?
options: 没有一次因子，但可能有二次因子
No linear factor, but quadratic factors may exist
It must have a repeated root
reason: 例如 (x²+x+1)² 无 𝔽₂ 根但可约。无根判别只对二、三次多项式等价于不可约。
For example (x²+x+1)² has no roots in 𝔽₂ but is reducible. The no-root test characterizes irreducibility only in degrees two and three.

question: 用模 2 判别法证明 x³+x+1 在 ℚ[x] 中不可约，写清每个条件。
Use reduction modulo 2 to prove x³+x+1 is irreducible over ℚ, stating the hypotheses.
reason: 它在 ℤ[x] 中本原，模 2 后首项仍为 1，次数保持 3。在 𝔽₂ 中 f(0)=1、f(1)=1，所以无根；三次无根意味着不可约。若在 ℚ[x] 中可约，高斯引理给出整数系数正次数分解，模 2 后次数保持，矛盾。

The polynomial is primitive and remains cubic modulo 2. Its values at 0 and 1 are both 1, so the cubic reduction has no linear factor and is irreducible. Gauss’s lemma would turn any rational factorization into an integer factorization whose degrees survive modulo 2, a contradiction.
